notice: Measured on the listed images and these simulated splices only. A test's score is a signal, not proof. An unusual reading can come from ordinary editing, and a normal reading doesn't show that an image is genuine.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.licence: Per-file open licences (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA), checked before download and listed in a manifest kept beside the images

limitations: Splices were simulated with rectangular patches, without the blending a careful editor would use. Real edits are likely to be harder to find.
Whole-image figures describe this collection. Commons images were often resized or re-saved before upload, and the 'edited' group holds many kinds of edit, most of which may not be local.
Images larger than 3.3 megapixels, and images re-saved by real social media platforms, were not measured.
Limits were set on real images from this collection, so false alarms elsewhere may be higher.
Labels are as stated by whoever ran this measurement. The tool does not check them.
